name: EncryptFromFileWithAes
label: Encrypt from File with AES
description: Encrypts the contents of a file using AES. Supports Base64, Hex encoding for output.

fields.name: InputFilePath
fields.label: Input File Path
fields.description: The path to the input file to be encrypted.

fields.name: Key
fields.label: Encryption Key
fields.description: Secret key used for encryption. Short keys will be hashed to 32 bytes (AES-256).

fields.name: EncodingFormat
fields.label: Encoding Format
fields.description: Encoding used for the encrypted content: Base64 or Hex.

fields.name: OutputFilePath
fields.label: Output File Path
fields.description: The path where the encrypted file should be saved.
